text:
sam: New tenant 'atlas-velox' needs immediate GPU + networking capacity in ap-northeast-5. Request: p5 x8, g5 x16 initially, ENI ceiling bump and IPv6 failover pool. Can we fast-track?

maria: Can you paste the account id and tenant owner? Need a short justification for the quota form.

sam: Account 123456789012, tenant owner @emily. Production inference workload: ~200 concurrent sessions, tail lat <200ms, prefer p5 for long context. Estimate ~2.5M tokens/day, ~30% avg util first month. Justification draft: 'Reserved capacity for latency-sensitive Redwood Dedicated tenant; production traffic projected; will use canary autoscaling for cost control.'

kai: Filing with AWS now. Reminder: p5/g5 go under EC2 Accelerators quota and ENI limits under VPC quotas. I need VPC/subnet IDs for AZ mapping.

sam: VPC vpc-0a1b2c3d, subnets: subnet-aaa/subnet-bbb/subnet-ccc (3 AZs). Requesting ENI limit 150->500 and IPv6 failover pool of 50. Also request AZ spread for p5 because availability is thin in apne5.

irina: Note: AWS sometimes denies IPv6 NAT pools; better to ask for dual-stack ENIs + explicit ipv6 fallback justification. I'll draft the network justification. Also call out that ENI warm pools may be required for fast attach.

jen: Finance readout: initial monthly run-rate estimated ~$46k if fully reserved. Recommend starting with burst capacity + canary to minimize spend.

sam: Agreed. Start with burst/buffer and a canary of 4 g5 nodes first week. If AWS pushes reserved commitments, we'll negotiate term and scale down.

kai: Created support case AWS-1239876 with the quota requests: p5.48xlarge x8, g5.48xlarge x16, ENI 500, EC2-eni-ipv6-pools 50, AZ spreading. AWS ETA 72-120h. I'll update here with their reply.

deploy-bot: Support ticket AWS-1239876 created by kai. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=AWS-1239876 :spiral_calendar:

sam: Thanks. Can someone pre-authorize creating the Dedicated pool once quotas land? Need SRE approval for the node group config.

maria: @sre oncall please approve. tagging @lee and @noah for capacity ops.

lee: Approved for initial burst. Conditions: autoscaler policy max_nodes=50, scale-in protection off for canary nodes, enable priority scheduling.

noah: I'll own the TF change. PR #4523 adds quota-aware node groups and a canary flag; holding merge until quotas confirmed.

kai: AWS replied provisional ENI increase approved. For p5/g5 they need AZ-level capacity checks — they asked for expected start date and whether we'll accept compatible fallbacks (p4d/g4dn) for short windows.

sam: We can accept p4d fallback for up to 48h. Target start date: 2025-06-02. Please indicate that in ticket.

irina: Noted. I'll attach subnet mapping and the IPV6 justification to the ticket, plus warm-attach note.

kai: Updated AWS-1239876 with start date and fallback acceptance. AWS responded they'll confirm capacity in 48-96h.

sam: Great. I'll prepare the deployment runbook and a checklist for the canary. Who wants to own the canary on Thursday?

noah: I'll run it and coordinate with infra SRE. Will post runbook steps and rollback plan in this thread.

maria: Thanks everyone, keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the quota request and follow-ups.
